# Regulatory Compliance and Risk Review

This document outlines key tasks for the department:

*   Update the internal control standard.
*   Investigate AML detection quarterly.
*   Review legal risks urgently.
*   Review regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   Review the internal control standard update.
